fields.Current State: Shaken by an arcane attack in its own simulation chamber and the named threat of Vocath.
fields.Overview (Player): Caelestis is the spelljammer academy where the cadets train, a layered machine of halls, ranks, and access permissions overlooking the Astral Sea. Led by Mirt, it is currently tense from a spreading wave of thefts.

bullets: Hosted the cadets' first day: a simulated battle, orientation, cadet quarters, sky dock, quartermaster's stores, Nexus helm exercise, and gymnasium
Revealed as a machine of access and hierarchy governed by halls, ranks, thresholds, and access stars
Grown tense from recent thefts; a wave of burglaries struck across the tower during the attack on Mirt
Led by Mirt, with Boatswain and Joffrey named among its great spelljammers
Received the new wilder cadet Bartholomew into a crew of six
Ran a salvage race between two cadet crews in the Simulation Deck
Struck again by theft, this time of Saerthe's own named miniature spelljamming ship
Nearly killed a chamber of cadets when an arcane device detonated during the salvage simulation
Governs a fleet-intelligence archive locked behind clearance the cadets cannot yet access
Granted the crew sailor-level clearance and dispatched them, aboard a tyrant ship, to recover a meteor that struck H’catha
